children: A suspected hacker sold 5,270 ETH at $1,805 two days ago for $9.51 million, then placed buy-limit orders between $1,551 and $1,568; all the orders were filled today. According to Odaily, the trader now holds a 14,000 ETH long position worth about $23.8 million, with $2.13 million in unrealized profits.

title: Suspected Hacker Sells 5,270 ETH, Buys Back Lower and Now Has $2.13 Million in Unrealized Gains
